pcs.pc_description: Identify what different routine testing is to be done in a CBG plant
Know significance of regular calibration
Understand how to measure Total Solids (TS) in a slurry
Test volatile solids (VS) in TS
Test pH in a digester
Test other parameters like total alkalinity and temperature etc
Measure methane and CO2 content in biogas
Monitor other important parameters like COD, BOD, nutrients, metals, Nitrogen, Phosphorous, Potassium etc
Know the working of different online analysers and laboratory equipments
Follow proper sampling procedure and frequency of testing as per manufacturer protocols and SOPs
Report the data as per prescribed format to the operator
Appreciate importance of system inspection & maintenance
Identify routine versus major maintenance
Know the Impact of Process Conditions on Frequency of maintenance
Check digester tanks periodically for leaks, cracks, or other evidence of structural problems
periodically check and operate pressure relief valves (PRVs)
Check the piping and equipment for leaks daily
Monitor the corrosion on a regular basis
Replace any Worn or damaged seals and/or drive belt in a pump
Check the mechanical mixers for any excessive vibration and rectify the same
Identify any fouling of the mixer blades and clear any deposited scale/cake etc
Monitor the working of compressor and change the oil as and when required
Check and change the particulate filter, Coalescing filters and O-rings etc
Perform regular tasks like checking for leaks, verifying proper calibration and operation of the instrumentation, biogas analysers in a H2S removal system
check coolant temperature, glycol-water solution level, and drive belts etc in the moisture removal system
Replace the membrane filter cartridges in membrane-based CO2 removal system or the adsorbents in a pressure swing adsorption (PSA) based CO2 removal system
Ensure proper working of gas detection system to prevent any accident
